education.detail: Board of Intermediate Education, Sri Vivekananda Junior College, Giddalur, 1985

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Case 1 (S.C. 5/2019, sections 120B/143/341/435/149) includes IPC 435 (mischief by fire/explosive, max 7 years) and qualifies; the Andhra Pradesh government ordered withdrawal of prosecution and the High Court granted an interim stay in 2021. Case 2 (Cr.No.220/2023, sections 143/188/341/149) does not qualify. Charges are not framed in either case; zero convictions.
